title: Account Age Scaling of Scheduled Payout Limits, Northloop Payments
content:
**Rule.** The payout limit of a Northloop Payments scheduled payout is scaled by the account-age payout-limit multiplier. The account-age payout-limit multiplier is 0.6 when the payments account was opened fewer than 730 calendar days before the payout date; it is 0.8 when it was opened at least 730 but fewer than 1095 (1,095) calendar days before; otherwise it is 1.

The age is the number of calendar days from the opening date of the payments account to the payout date.

## Ladder

| Calendar days from the opening date of the payments account to the payout date | Account-age payout-limit multiplier |
|---|---|
| fewer than 730 | 0.6 |
| at least 730 and fewer than 1095 | 0.8 |
| 1095 or more | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Account opened ... calendar days before the payout date | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 729 | 0.6 |
| 730 | 0.8 |
| 1094 | 0.8 |
| 1095 | 1 |
